Questions we get asked

How much does social media management cost?

We work on monthly packages. Pricing depends on the number of posts, reels and shoots, and on the market (Egypt or Saudi Arabia). Send us your brief and we’ll reply with a proposal.

Do you work with brands in Saudi Arabia?

Yes. We run campaigns and productions in both Egypt and Saudi Arabia, with an influencer network across the Gulf and Jordan.

Do you shoot the content yourselves?

Yes. Photography, video, editing and design are done by our in-house production team.

Which platforms do you manage?

Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, including paid campaigns on Meta and TikTok.

Tell us about your brand and we’ll send you a tailored proposal.
